name: dev-shot-grammar
description: Cinematic shot-decision grammar for building a shot list: shot size, camera angle, camera height, movement, composition, continuity/cutting and transitions, each mapped to its narrative job. Use when choosing how to frame each beat or when checking continuity across a sequence. Do NOT use for staging the environment or lighting (dev-mise-en-scene), for producing an H3 prompt, or for a single static description you already have.
